title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (illness) out against Bucs
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (illness) is out against the Bucs on Thursday with an illness. He was originally slated to play and off the injury report.
items.impact: It's a bummer for the Dallas defense who just acquired him last week. However, it shouldn't keep him out more than this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (foot) was limited at Miami's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wright is a new addition to Miami's injury report, being listed with a foot injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Thursday. Fantasy managers should closely monitor his participation at practice on Friday, as Ollie Gordon II will be primed for a massive workload this week if Wright is unable to play against the Bengals on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (ankle) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie wasn't able to take part in Miami's practice on Thursday. He did some drills off to the side, but he still isn't healthy enough to make his return to practice. He isn't likely to play in Week 5, which will once again leave Malik Washington and Chris Bell (knee) with more work against the Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Storm Duck (knee) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Storm Duck (knee) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Duck was able to practice in full again on Thursday, making him extremely likely to play without limitations in Week 5. His presence will be needed ahead of a tough matchup against Joe Burrow and the Bengals this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: JuJu Brents (heel) limited Thursday
items.desc: JuJu Brents (heel) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young cornerback is uncertain to play in Week 5 after being limited at two-straight practices to start the week. Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will both have an easier time this week if the Dolphins are without Brents on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Austin Jackson (knee) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Austin Jackson (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Jackson has been limited for two-straight practices to start the week. Miami's defense will look even weaker than usual this week if they are without their starting right tackle in a matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bell was able to participate in a limited fashion at practice on Thursday, which was to be expected, given that the injury is not considered more than a minor issue at this point. It shouldn't affect his availability for Week 5, but fantasy managers shouldn't consider him more than a streaming option at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Allen (rest/knee) misses practice again Thursday
items.desc: Jonathan Allen (rest/knee) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It was thought that Allen was only absent from practice on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, but he wasn't able to practice on Thursday either and is now listed with a knee issue of some kind. It may very well leave him sidelined in Week 5, which would be bad news for Cincinnati's defense ahead of a favorable matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dexter Lawrence II (wrist) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Dexter Lawrence II (wrist) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The star defensive lineman was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday due to a wrist injury. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 5, but in the off-chance that he doesn't, Cincinnati's defense will be much weaker than usual in a favorable matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Dugger (quad) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Dugger (quad) was absent from Cincinnati's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cincinnati's veteran safety missed another practice on Thursday, which means he's trending the wrong way for Week 5. Their defense will be weaker than usual if he's out against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Risner (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Risner (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Risner was limited for another practice on Thursday. It seems likely that he will play through his knee injury this week, but we won't get an official injury designation for him until after the team's last practice of the week on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The star wideout was able to return to practice as a limited participant on Thursday. That's a big step in the right direction, and it gives him a real chance to clear the NFL's concussion protocols in time for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. Fantasy managers should have no hesitations starting him if he's active this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) officially did not practice for the Bengals on Thursday.
items.impact: Higgins seems to be trending towards being sidelined in Week 5, as he was not able to participate in a second-straight practice on Thursday due to injury. If he's sidelined this week, fantasy managers should expect RB Chase Brown and TE Mike Gesicki to both see more work in the passing game as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Shough (hand) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Shough (hand) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New Orleans' starting quarterback was limited on Wednesday due to an injury to his non-throwing hand, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 5, which is good news for the fantasy value of Chris Olave (foot), Juwan Johnson, and Alvin Kamara (back) ahead of a tough matchup against the Vikings.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (back) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kamara was able to make his return to practice on Thursday, although only in a limited capacity due to the back injury that he's dealing with. It looks like he will be available to play in Week 5, but he doesn't project to have a big week for fantasy purposes between the injury and the tough matchup against the Vikings.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Noah Fant (abdomen) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Noah Fant (abdomen) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Fant was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an injury to his abdomen. He seems to be trending towards playing in Week 5, but we won't know his status for sure until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Olave (foot) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Chris Olave (foot) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Olave is now being listed with a foot issue that left him limited at practice on Thursday. It doesn't seem to be a major issue for the star wideout, but fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status heading into the weekend to make sure he's going to suit up, play, and see a full workload against the Vikings this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Chris Brooks (ankle) did not take part in Green Bay's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brooks was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an ankle injury of some kind. It looks like he's going to be sidelined in Week 5, which will leave MarShawn Lloyd as Green Bay's top running back in their matchup against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Savion Williams (ankle) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Savion Williams (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The Packers recently opened Williams' 21-day practice window, and he was able to practice in a limited fashion for a second-straight day on Thursday. He may play in Week 5, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have much of a fantasy impact even if he's cleared to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) was listed as limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Van Ness was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to manage a nagging shoulder issue of some kind. He should be available to play in Week 5, however, and the Packers will need him to play and perform well this week if they want to slow down Chicago's offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacob Monk (quad) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Jacob Monk (quad) was absent from Green Bay's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Green Bay continues to struggle with numerous injuries to their offensive front. Monk is among them and wasn't able to practice on Thursday due to a quad injury. He seems likely to be sidelined in Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, the veteran missed another practice on Thursday due to the same issues that have been bothering him for several weeks. He's unlikely to play in Week 5, which will again leave Green Bay's offensive line weaker than usual ahead of a matchup against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cosmi has missed some time due to a concussion and throat issue, but he was officially upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday and seems likely to play in Week 5. Washington's offensive front will see a nice boost if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Treylon Burks (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Treylon Burks (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Burks was able to log another full practice session on Thursday. His shoulder injury isn't serious and he is expected to play through it this week, and he may see more work than usual against the Giants with Terry McLaurin (hamstring) and Stefon Diggs (hamstring) both at risk of being sidelined for that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Rachaad White (shoulder) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a shoulder injury of some kind. It seems like he's trending towards playing in Week 5, however, which would be less than ideal for the fantasy value of Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) against the Giants this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was able to log another limited practice session on Thursday. His hamstring injury isn't serious at this point, however, and he is expected to play through it in this week's matchup against the Giants.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (quad) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Jeremy McNichols (quad) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McNichols was again limited at practice on Thursday. He's still in his 21-day practice window and has yet to be officially activated, so it remains to be seen whether or not he will be a part of Washington's backfield rotation in Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) limited Thursday
items.desc: Frankie Luvu (groin) was limited for another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Washington's standout defender was again limited on Thursday due to the same groin injury that he's been managing for a while. It doesn't seem like much of a threat to his availability for Week 5, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Sinnott (elbow) a full participant Thursday
items.desc: Ben Sinnott (elbow) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was able to log a full practice session on Thursday, despite being limited by an elbow injury on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 5 but doesn't project to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The young running back has been limited at both of Washington's practices to start the week. He's still day-to-day with a groin issue, but it looks like he's trending towards playing through it this week. However, fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him even if he's fully healthy for this matchup against the Giants.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at Washington's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McLaurin was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to nurse a hamstring injury of some kind. He may very well be sidelined in Week 5, which would be bad news for the fantasy value of QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) against the Giants, especially if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is also sidelined.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran is still recovering from a hamstring injury and was officially a non-participant at practice again on Thursday, despite being present. It looks like he's trending the wrong way for Week 5, and his absence would significantly hurt the fantasy value of QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) ahead of a divisional matchup against the Giants on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Manhertz (shoulder) limited Thursday
items.desc: Chris Manhertz (shoulder) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Manhertz was limited at practice as he continues to manage a shoulder injury of some kind. He doesn't see much work as a receiver in New York's offense, however, so his potential absence this week wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran took part in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion, which puts him in line to play in Week 5. His presence is important for the fantasy output of New York's entire offense on a week-to-week basis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deonte Banks (calf) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Deonte Banks (calf) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Banks was able to log yet another full practice session on Thursday. He should play at full capacity in Week 5, which is good news for New York's defense in a favorable matchup against the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Najee Harris (personal) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Najee Harris (personal) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being absent from practice on Wednesday due to a personal issue of some kind. He should be good to go for Week 5 and should continue to be an involved depth piece on this offense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) was limited at New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Skattebo was a limited participant at practice on Thursday. He's still dealing with a shoulder issue of some kind and is likely considered day-to-day for the time being. It looks likely that he will play in Week 5, and he will have a good opportunity to put up some real fantasy points this week in a favorable matchup against the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) officially limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nabers was a non-participant at New York's practice on Wednesday due to a knee issue, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he was able to return and practice in a limited fashion on Thursday. It looks likely that he will play in Week 5, and fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him if he gets full clearance to play against the Commanders on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Isaiah Likely (knee/groin) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Isaiah Likely (knee/groin) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a pair of injuries. He seems likely to play in Week 5, but we won't know his official status until the team releases their final practice report after Friday's practice.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Hamilton (groin) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton (groin) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hamilton was able to practice in full on Thursday after being limited by a groin issue on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 5, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to take part in another practice on Thursday as he continues to nurse a pair of lower-body injuries. Baltimore's secondary will be weaker than usual in Week 5 if he is sidelined for their matchup against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Jurgens (concussion) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Cam Jurgens (concussion) missed Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jurgens was recently traded from Philadelphia to the Ravens, but he's currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice on Thursday. He seems likely to be sidelined this week, which means Baltimore's offense will have to wait at least one more week to reap the benefits of having him in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined at Wednesday's practice due to a couple of minor issues that he was dealing with, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was able to practice in full. He should be good to go for Week 5, which is great news for Baltimore's offense ahead of a tough matchup against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited again Thursday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Simpson was again limited on Thursday as he continues to nurse a nagging groin issue. He should be available to play in Week 5, however, and Baltimore's offensive line should be mostly healthy with Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) now back at practice as well.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Moore was able to practice in full on Thursday after being limited by an ankle injury on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 5 but doesn't project to have much fantasy value moving forward, especially with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) likely to be out for the Ravens this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) was absent from Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hendrickson was not able to practice again on Thursday. That's not very surprising, considering that he recently underwent a surgery to repair his broken finger. It looks like he's going to be sidelined in Week 5, which would be bad news for Baltimore's defense in a matchup against the red-hot Falcons' offense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bateman was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being limited by a shoulder injury on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Sunday night's game but doesn't project to be a good fantasy option against the Falcons, especially if QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is sidelined for the Ravens.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (foot) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Flowers was able to participate in practice for a second-straight day on Thursday, but he remained limited due to a foot injury that is bothering him currently. It looks like he will play in Week 5, but we won't know what his status is for sure until the team released their final injury report after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jackson missed a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to nurse an ankle injury that he suffered last week. He seems like a long-shot to play in Week 5, which would leave Tyler Huntley as the starting quarterback for the Ravens in what projects to be a tough matchup against the red-hot Falcons on Sunday night.
